feedbackPage.review1: PDF merge is incredibly useful, saves me so much time!
feedbackPage.review2: Clean interface and easy language switching. Love it.
feedbackPage.review3: Image compression is great, barely any quality loss.
feedbackPage.review4: Video to GIF is super fast, perfect for memes.
feedbackPage.review5: Love having all these tools in one place. So handy.
feedbackPage.review6: Audio format support is comprehensive and easy to use.
feedbackPage.review7: Can't wait for more AI tools in future updates!
feedbackPage.review8: Color picker is essential for my design work.
feedbackPage.review9: Runs smoothly without annoying ads. Great experience.
feedbackPage.review10: Text diff helps me find changes quickly. Very useful.
feedbackPage.review11: Online whiteboard is handy for quick sketches.
feedbackPage.review12: Random spinner decided my lunch today. Fun and useful!
